create.name: Cindy Novelo
create.bio:
Cindy Novelo is a mindfulness meditation and yoga teacher, and a touring singer-songwriter, based in her home town of Lawrence, Kansas. After nearly two decades abroad, studying and performing in France, playing viola in Costa Rica and raising a family on an island off Belize, she came back to Kansas and returned to music in 2009. She has taught yoga since 2005 and mindfulness since 2018, having completed the Mindfulness Meditation Teacher Certification Program with Jack Kornfield and Tara Brach and trained with James Baraz as an Awakening Joy teacher. Since 2020 she has also helped facilitate Tara Brach's Wednesday evening Mindful Dialogue group, and she counts Thich Nhat Hanh and Sharon Salzberg among her influences.

Her teaching leans towards compassion, and above all self-compassion, alongside learning to notice the good in ordinary life, the theme of her own Seeing the Good mindfulness courses. She leads weekly yoga classes in person at Bluestem Yoga in Lawrence and online for students in several countries, and often plays viola, guitar or singing bowls while students rest at the end. She also holds a monthly online women's sangha in the Insight tradition, offered on a donation basis, runs women's retreats and workshops, and sees people for private yoga and meditation sessions.

courses.title: Weekly Yoga Classes
courses.description: An all-levels class on Zoom on Tuesday evenings, plus hatha and gentle restorative classes in person at Bluestem Yoga in Lawrence. Classes weave together postures, breath, meditation and yoga philosophy, and usually end with live music during the final resting pose.
courses.price: $13 USD per online class; $49 USD four-class month pass (online); studio classes booked through Bluestem Yoga

courses.title: Private Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one yoga and meditation sessions online, at a studio or in your home, shaped around what you want to work on, from a particular pose to starting a meditation practice. Packages of six or ten sessions are available.
courses.price: $95 USD per hour online or at a studio; $135 USD per hour at home

courses.title: Reset & Restore Yoga
courses.description: A gentle Sunday evening class at Bluestem Yoga in Lawrence that combines breathing and mindfulness practices, meditation, soft stretching and restful poses, sometimes with yoga nidra. In autumn and winter it is held by candlelight.

free_resources.title: Women's Mindfulness Meditation Circle (sangha)
free_resources.description: A monthly online gathering on Zoom for women to meditate together, share experiences and study, in the spirit of the Insight tradition. There is no fee; donations (dana) are welcome. The linked page is the 19 November 2026 session.
